name: Chronomancer: Decomposition consumes Echo Fragments for more damage (#7431)
contract: Decomposition 800856 (and ranks 801028-801033, 802597) reads 'Damage increased by $804455s1% for each Echo Fragment consumed', gated on knowing 92120. Echo Fragment 804455 is the class-22 threshold resource (max 5 stacks); its Effect 0 (aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, BasePoints 24 + DieSides 1) resolves to +25% per consumed fragment. No cost rule or cast hook covered Decomposition, so Echo Fragments stayed on the character and the cast dealt base damage. chronomancer_secondary_casts now counts the fragments on a Decomposition cast, removes the aura and stashes the count on the spell; chronomancer_secondary_hits multiplies the applied DoT's Effect 0 amount by (100 + 25 * consumed) / 100. With no fragments nothing is removed or changed, so base casts are untouched.

steps.label: SETUP: one Echo Fragment is held
